# FastSpaceSwitch

> Free, MIT-licensed macOS 26 utility for instant Ctrl+Left and Ctrl+Right switching between Spaces without the slide animation. Made by Hadi Al-Musawi.

- [Overview, installation, and questions](https://hadi-almusawi.github.io/fast-space-switch/)
- [How it works](https://hadi-almusawi.github.io/fast-space-switch/how-it-works.html)
- [Source](https://github.com/Hadi-Almusawi/fast-space-switch)
- [Latest release](https://github.com/Hadi-Almusawi/fast-space-switch/releases/latest)
- [Site privacy](https://hadi-almusawi.github.io/fast-space-switch/privacy.html)

Version: 1.1.1. Price: free. No paid plan or account.
Built for macOS Tahoe 26. macOS 27 is not supported. Older versions and Intel hardware are not tested. Download includes Apple Silicon and Intel code.
Instant Ctrl+Left/Right requires Accessibility permission. Does not require disabling SIP.
The --no-permission install mode does not launch the app. It keeps native Ctrl+Left/Right with the usual slide while setting the Dock window-view animation time to zero for Ctrl+Up/Down.
Only registers Ctrl+Left and Ctrl+Right. No other key recording, screen reading, or network requests in the app.
Ctrl+Up/Down remain macOS shortcuts for Mission Control and the current app's windows. Installer sets the Dock's window-view animation time to zero and restores the old value on uninstall. It may also affect those views when opened by trackpad. Does not change Reduce Motion. No custom shortcuts or numbered-desktop selection.
Uses private macOS features that may change. Not notarized by Apple.
Installer changes two built-in Space shortcuts. Uninstaller restores them.
Swipe technique adapted from jurplel's InstantSpaceSwitcher (MIT).
